name: ripple-button
title: Ripple Button
description: Button that sends a ripple out from the click point, or from the center when pressed with the keyboard.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style, the same set as Button.

props.name: size
props.description: Height 32, 40, or 48px, the same as Button.

a11y: A native button element, so Enter and Space work and focus shows a 2px primary outline.
Ripples live in an aria-hidden layer and are removed when they finish.
With prefers-reduced-motion no ripple is drawn, the click still works.

ai.whenToUse: Actions that benefit from tactile feedback, such as add to cart, subscribe, or a submit button.
rules: Use it like Button, onClick and type behave the same
Do not mix ripple and plain buttons in the same toolbar
The ripple takes the text color, so it works on every variant

id.description: Tombol yang memancarkan gelombang dari titik klik, atau dari tengah saat ditekan dengan keyboard.
a11y: Elemen button native, jadi Enter dan Spasi berfungsi dan fokus tampil sebagai outline 2px warna primary.
Gelombang berada di lapisan aria-hidden dan dihapus setelah selesai.
Dengan prefers-reduced-motion tidak ada gelombang, klik tetap berfungsi.

ai.whenToUse: Aksi yang terbantu umpan balik sentuhan, seperti tambah ke keranjang, berlangganan, atau tombol kirim.
rules: Pakai seperti Button, onClick dan type berperilaku sama
Jangan campur ripple button dan tombol biasa dalam satu toolbar
Gelombang memakai warna teks, jadi cocok di semua varian
